step1_pattern.operation: 3 个周转天数（平均余额 ÷ 流量 × 365）再加减
notes: GT FY2024 用平均余额、FY2023 用期末余额，口径不一致
GT FY2023 的 CCC 算式写 "−107.6"，与上一行 DPO 124.6 矛盾（结果 −39.8 与 124.6 一致，107.6 是笔误）

changes_vs_seed: 旧题与新题成对生成：旧题 = 原题补全公司、财年、必答指标、单位和关键口径；新题 = 旧题只替换时间
评分点只覆盖题目要求的内容；不再使用替代口径（口径已在题干写明）
旧题的标准答案按同一口径用原期间数据重算（更正原 GT 中的错误）
step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's cash conversion cycle for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Report the cash conversion cycle in days, rounded to one decimal place.
step5_question.old_question: What was the cash conversion cycle of Procter & Gamble (P&G) for fiscal year 2024 (ended June 30, 2024), using average balances (beginning and end of year) and a 365-day year, and how does it compare with fiscal year 2023 on the same basis? Report the cash conversion cycle for both years in days, rounded to one decimal place, and state whether it increased or decreased.

notes: 主答案用平均余额；期末余额口径为也接受
CCC 为负值：从 −44.4 到 −40.9 是"上升"
